image_description: A highly ornate, baroque-style church interior featuring a grand altar as the central focal point. The altar is part of a larger altarpiece structure with gold leaf detailing, columns, statues in niches, and religious paintings. The foreground shows floral arrangements and candle holders on the altar table. The architecture includes arches, domes, and intricate stonework.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific architectural and religious classification of the structure as an altar within a church context.
To verify the complex spatial relationships between the foreground altar, the mid-ground altarpiece, and the background dome/arches, ensuring no geometric melting or depth collapse.
To check for boundary bleeding or fusion in the highly detailed gold leaf carvings and statues, which are common failure points in AI generation.
To assess the overall coherence of lighting, texture consistency on the marble and gold, and detect any subtle atmospheric artifacts.

focus_areas: Structural integrity of the complex altarpiece columns and arches.
Clarity and separation of small ornate details (gold leaf, statues).
Consistency of perspective in the ceiling dome and background walls.
Texture realism of marble vs. gilded wood vs. fabric.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the intersection of the altar table and the floor. In AI images, heavy ornate objects often float or lack proper shadow grounding. Also, inspect the faces of the statues in the niches; AI often distorts facial features in small, distant figures. Verify if the text on any banners or books is coherent or gibberish.
